evidence.priorRequalification: Warm vignette and amber glow overlap the crystal/armor boundary; subject-color similarity prevents safe flat-region extraction.

species.safetyFinding: Background and protected amber glow share color/luminance at the subject boundary; any threshold, gradient subtraction, or matte would either erase glow/edge pixels or leave the background plate.
species.reason: Existing pixels do not provide a provably safe separation. Repair would violate the protected-glow rule or require reconstruction.
